top_signals.title: Vail Resorts Wins Large Shareholder Support in Fight with Oasis
top_signals.summary: Baron Capital, one of Vail Resorts Inc.’s largest shareholders, is supporting the company and its nominees, as the ski resort company tries to fend off a proxy fight against activist investor Oasis Management.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
